tldr: The headline is a constructive uniform \(N^{-1/3}\log^2(N+1)\) upper certificate for Gaussian calibration of every saturated factorial effect under one pooled complete assignment with bounded replication. The entire bounded fixed-table class, all real thresholds, and only a marginal assignment-variance floor are retained, including singular covariance. The existing common-outcome table also supplies a credited central-threshold lattice obstruction of order \(\sqrt{\log N/N}\), now transferred and proved on this same class. These upper and lower orders do not match. Oracle critical-value tolerances and certified Gaussian evaluation are supporting consequences; the large displayed upper constant gives no practical precision guarantee at ordinary sample sizes.
